journey.name: Lift: a finished program's recap and the next cycle
journey.description: A program's last day done, the session's summary closes onto the program's recap: what it came to, how much of the plan was done, how each lift moved, the records set, and the next cycle as a coach would call it, its button doing what it says. A beginner's program done well moves on to the next program for the bells owned; a program with days missed or sets left eases in; any other goes again from the loads last lifted. Run on an install following "Kettlebell foundations" with every day but its last logged, and a 16 kg and a 24 kg bell owned.

actions.action: Tap the "Train" tab, which opens on "Strength", then "Start day 12" on the program's card
Tap "Log set" for each set up next until "Up next" is gone, then "Finish"
Verify that the summary says "Kettlebell foundations finished · every day done" and that its button reads "See the recap" rather than "Close"
Tap "See the recap"; if asked "Keep today's changes?", tap "Drop"

Verify that the program's page shows "Finished", the days done, reps and weight moved, then "Next cycle" with "Ready to move on", "You did N of N planned sets." and the program it names, then "How the lifts moved" with each lift's first and last best set ("16 kg × 10 → 24 kg × 10")
Tap "Follow" and the program named, and verify the notice says it is followed and the page shows its day 1
